guitar.evidence: Jimmy Nolen, James Brown's longtime guitarist, pioneered the funk "chicken scratch" rhythm style on Fender Telecaster/Stratocaster, well documented in funk guitar history.

tone.target: tight bright funk clean with sharp attack
tone.profile: tight bright funk clean with sharp attack
tone.summary: A tight, compressed signal chain using a light boost/compressor, followed by a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe), emphasizing the upper mids for that classic funk bite. Minimal effects are used to maintain dryness and clarity.

rig.name: The James Brown Band - I Feel Good (I Got You) - Valeton GP-180
